text:
maria: quick sync — followup from last night's authz incident. i enumerated the remediation items that need owners and timelines. TL;DR: two short fixes, one medium rollout, and a recurring audit task.
jamal: thanks maria. can you paste the list? i'll pick up anything infra-y.
maria: list below — please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept: 1) fix token validation edge-case for service-to-service tokens (SAML->JWT mismatch) — owner: @jamal — ETA: 48h 2) restore filtered audit ingestion for expiring keys (missing fields causing drops) — owner: @sophia — ETA: 5d 3) add gating to secrets-rotation CI job to fail if last-rotation > 90d — owner: @alex — ETA: 3d 4) recurring: weekly drift report for privileged roles + automated alert — owner: ops (we need a human owner) — proposal: rotate owner monthly — ETA: proposal by EOW
jamal: taking #1. I'll start with a repro and a hotfix branch.
alex: taking #3. i can add the gating check to the rotation pipeline and add a dashboard panel.
sophia: taking #2. looks like the audit pipeline had a schema regression after the last ingestion change. I'll add backwards-compat checks.
devin: for the recurring drift report — i can volunteer as continuity owner for the next 30 days and rotate to security-rotation@ in ops after that.
maria: perfect. devin please own the handoff doc and add the monthly rotation assignee list. small ask: include a one-click runbook for emergencies.
jamal: quick note on #1: reproduced locally, failure happens when exp claim missing aud and our validator treats as valid for legacy services. patch idea: require either aud OR service_id and log mismatch to audit-log.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4921 for audit-ingest-schema-fix (linked to this thread).
sophia: thanks @ops-bot — added reproduction logs to INC-4921. for ETA, aiming to complete analysis in 24h then a staged rollout to non-prod.
alex: dev note for #3: adding this check is two parts: 1) pipeline gate to check last rotation timestamp 2) alert rule. i will open PR with both. sample check: `jq -r .last_rotation < secret-metadata.json | awk -F- '{print $1}'` (we'll replace with internal SDK call).
maria: can we also add a short retrospective note about the recurring pattern? this is the 3rd time in 9 months where audit ingestion or rotation tooling drifted after a small change. my proposal: add a post-change smoke test for audit coverage + require at least one consumer contract test on PRs touching ingestion.
devin: +1 to consumer contract test. we can add a check that runs a lightweight ingest and validates required fields. i'll draft the test harness.
jamal: for the hotfix I'll open a PR to patch validator and add an integration test. if tests are green i'll request an expedited canary to prod-legacy for 2 hours then full rollout.
sophia: timeline note: i expect to finish schema fix analysis in 24h then patch + canary in 72h.
maria: action items recap (for backfill into postmortem): Jamal -> token validation hotfix (48h), Sophia -> audit ingest fix (5d), Alex -> rotation CI gate + alert (3d), Devin -> weekly drift report + handoff doc (EOW). ops-bot please create checklist items in INC-4920 and ping us on completion.
ops-bot: Checklist created in INC-4920: [token-hotfix, audit-ingest-fix, rotation-gate, drift-report-handoff]. Reminder scheduled: weekly on mondays at 09:00 UTC.
alex: leaving a note — when we do the rotation gate, we should also add a non-blocking 'rotation age' metric in the console so teams can see risk before the gate fires.
maria: agree. i'll add that to the postmortem action list. final ask: everyone add a :white_check_mark: reaction when you have the PR/owner assigned so we can close the loop.
jamal: :white_check_mark:
alex: :white_check_mark:
sophia: :white_check_mark:
devin: :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all. i'll update the postmortem with owners and link INC-4920/4921. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly and we'll triage.
